subject: Mutual action plan and reservation pricing — proposed MAP, evaluation, burst terms
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed MAP + eval window + reserved capacity sketch for Acme

Hi Lena —

Thanks again for the demo last week. As discussed, I put together a short mutual action plan (attached) that ties the evaluation milestones to commercial commitments for Dedicated capacity so your team can validate performance and cost at scale. High level:

- 2-week evaluation (P0): 2x A100-equivalent GPUs in a shared dev pool to validate throughput and latency for your 1.5k concurrent sessions use case.
- Ramp (P1): month 2–3, provision 8x A100-equivalent in a dedicated pool for sustained QA and early production.
- Commit (P2): month 4+, customer signs a 12-month reservation for 8x pool with burst to 12x for occasional peaks; discounts kick in on signed commit and on hitting MAP milestones.

I attached a sizing & cost estimate (GPU_Sizing_Estimate_Acme.xlsx) and a draft MAP (Draft_MAP_Acme_v2.pdf). A few open commercial items we should confirm: pricing band for reserved 8x pool, the term length you prefer (12 vs 24 months), and the burst mechanics (minute-level billing or blended caps).

Can you confirm Acme's target close date for procurement? You mentioned end of May as a stretch — if we can align on milestones and a DocuSign window, we can lock the quoted pricing for 30 days.

Next steps proposed:
1) You review attached MAP & sizing this week.
2) We host a 30-minute call Friday to walk pricing and burst rules.
3) Sign a short SOW and reservation order to begin the 2-week eval the following Monday.

Happy to adjust the cadence — let me know who on procurement should be looped in.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142

Attachments: Draft_MAP_Acme_v2.pdf (26KB stub), GPU_Sizing_Estimate_Acme.xlsx (12KB stub)

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acmeanalytics.com
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2026 10:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Proposed MAP + eval window + reserved capacity sketch for Acme

Sean —

Thanks for this — the attachments look helpful. A couple of clarifying questions before I schedule the Friday call:

1) Pricing bands: can you give an example monthly run-rate for the 8x reserved pool (list price) and the committed-discount price at 12-month term? We need concrete numbers to include in our finance review.
2) Burst: we typically see 3–4x traffic spikes for short periods (minutes). Are bursts billed as a per-minute incremental rate or do you do a blended cap? We need clarity on cost predictability.
3) MAP milestones & credits: can you outline what percentage discount/credit we receive at the P0 (eval complete) and P1 (ramp) milestones versus only at P2 commit? Our legal & finance teams will want to see an explicit schedule.

Procurement note: procurement@acmeanalytics.com handles the PO and contract redlines. Our internal timeline is aggressive — we want to finish procurement and sign by 31 May if possible. If the MAP includes a small evaluation credit for P0, that will help speed approval.

Looping in Tom from procurement (procurement@acmeanalytics.com) — can you share an example SOW and a sample reservation order?

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
VP, Product Ops | Acme Analytics
Lena.Oritz@acmeanalytics.com

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2026 08:25:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Proposed MAP + eval window + reserved capacity sketch for Acme — pricing ask from customer

Ben/Marissa —

Lena asked for concrete numbers to include in their finance review and for clarity on burst billing and milestone credits. Procurement timeline target: sign by 31 May. They also said a small eval credit for P0 would materially help accelerate approval.

Proposed commercial approach (please critique):
- Sizing: reserved pool = 8x A100-equivalent (baseline), burst up to 12x for <10% of minutes.
- Term/price: list = $48,000/month for 8x pool (month-to-month reservation equivalent). 12-month reserved commit = $36,000/month (25% discount) billed monthly. 24-month = $32,400/month (32.5% discount).
- Burst: allow automatic burst to 12x; burst usage billed at 50% of the incremental on-demand rate, with a blended monthly cap equal to 20% of baseline reservation cost. Example: if they burst 1,000 minutes, charges are X but capped so they never exceed +20% of the $36k baseline in a month. That gives predictability.
- MAP milestone credits: P0 (eval complete, pass perf & lat) = 10% credit applied to month 1 of the reservation once signed. P1 (successful ramp, throughput validated at scale) = additional 5% credit applied month 2. Final 10% new-customer discount applied on execution of the 12-month reservation. Credits stack but overall not to exceed 25%.

Open items: do we need an internal approvals escalation for a 25% effective discount? Also need legal to accept the burst cap language and ensure we can instrument minute-level usage for capping.

If we agree, I will send a revised MAP + SOW and a sample reservation order to Lena and procurement with the DocuSign link.

--Sean

[internal note: attachments for customer - Draft_MAP_Acme_v2.pdf, GPU_Sizing_Estimate_Acme.xlsx]

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acmeanalytics.com>, procurement@acmeanalytics.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 24 Apr 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Revised MAP, pricing details, and DocuSign — next steps to hit 31 May close

Hi Lena / Tom —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for sharing the procurement timeline. Per our internal alignment (cc'ed Ben and Marissa), please find the revised MAP and GPU sizing estimate attached. Below is a concise summary of the commercial terms we discussed — these are what we'll include in the reservation order and SOW:

1) Reserved capacity & sizing
- Baseline: 8x A100-equivalent reserved pool (sustained).
- Burst: automated up to 12x for short periods; burst minutes measured per-minute.

2) Pricing & term (examples)
- List (no commit): $48,000/month for 8x baseline.
- 12-month reservation: $36,000/month (25% off list).
- 24-month reservation: $32,400/month (32.5% off list).

3) Burst billing & cap
- Incremental burst billed at 50% of on-demand per-minute rate.
- Monthly blended cap: burst charges capped so total monthly charge does not exceed baseline reservation cost + 20%.
- Measurement & reporting: Redwood will provide per-minute burst logs and a monthly burst summary for finance reconciliation.

4) MAP milestone credits (applied after validation)
- P0 (eval pass): 10% credit applied to first reservation invoice after sign.
- P1 (ramp validated): 5% credit applied to second month invoice.
- New-customer execution discount: additional 10% applied on execution and reflected in the reservation price.
- Maximum stacking: credits/discounts will not exceed 25% total off list.

5) Timeline & next steps
- Lena: confirm MAP + SOW by Mon 27 Apr so we can prepare DocuSign and reservation order.
- Procurement: review attached SOW and reservation order (stub) and flag any redlines — we can accept minor redlines but need to keep termination language standard for reserved inventory.
- Target sign: by 31 May to preserve quoted pricing for 30 days from the DocuSign envelope creation.

I attached: Draft_MAP_Acme_v2.pdf (updated with the pricing above) and GPU_Sizing_Estimate_Acme.xlsx. DocuSign link will be created once you confirm the MAP language; I can send the envelope immediately.

If this looks good, we'll proceed to generate the reservation order and include the sample SOW for your legal to review.

Best,
